verdict.rationale: The only versioning evidence is the seller docs' use of the v2 Product Catalog Import API and v2.commerce.product_catalog.imports webhook event names, which point to a versioned API namespace. The pack never describes a versioning scheme, version pinning, or any deprecation or sunset policy. Missing for 10: documented API versioning model (version pinning/headers, upgrade path), documented deprecation policy and timelines, changelog or backward-compatibility guarantees for agentic endpoints, independent corroboration.
